title: Famous Landmarks
text:
The Pyramids are in Egypt. They are very old and very big. People built them a long time ago. Many tourists visit them every year.

The Statue of Liberty is in New York. It is green and very tall. It was a gift from France. It is a famous symbol of freedom.

questions.text: Where is the Statue of Liberty?
Why do many people visit the Pyramids?
options: Because they are small and new
Because they are famous and impressive
Because they are in the ocean
Because they are made of paper

questions.text: What can you guess about the Statue of Liberty?
options: It is a famous and important symbol

paragraph_translations: Піраміди знаходяться в Єгипті. Вони дуже старі та дуже великі. Люди побудували їх давно. Кожного року їх відвідують багато туристів.
Статуя Свободи знаходиться в Нью-Йорку. Вона зелена і дуже висока. Це був подарунок від Франції. Це відомий символ свободи.
